ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity pixels (black/dark-grey) with less than 5% high-intensity pixels originating from localized marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of macro-level pigmentation blobs; surface presents as a continuous low-intensity field with sparse, high-frequency white and light-grey pixel strings and circular clusters scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 45 degrees and a pixel depth significant relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across both trailing edges; right lobe (viewer perspective) displays more pronounced, jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep of the trailing edges originating from the notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple light-grey circular and oval pixel clusters (~10-20 pixels in diameter) concentrated in the central and right ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, high-contrast linear marks (scratches) oriented primarily on the left lobe, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular, high-contrast textural masses at both distal tips, indicating severe barnacle colonization or significant traumatic tissue alteration/amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Visibility of a secondary dorsal appendage protrusion positioned behind the central fluke notch.
